programme.title: Kaise Kahoon Ke...Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: Karan, a burglar, wishes to permanently leave his profession when he falls in love with Priya. They decide to get married, but Karan finds out that he has cancer.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes
programme.desc: ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed mother, is assigned to investigate the murder of a businessman. However, she suspects it to be a serial killer as more murders take place in the city.

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach
programme.desc: Govinda, an aspiring dancer, lives with his poor mother. In a turn of events, he is given a break to compete with Rocky, a famous dancer in the city.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Jaane Jigar
programme.desc: Two women look identical but hail from different backgrounds. They fall in love with Ravi and Vijay who are best friends. Misunderstandings arise when they believe they are in love with the same girl.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Mafia Raaj
programme.desc: An honest police officer has a mission to wipe out a mafia group. But in the process, he is forced to sacrifice not only his father but also his sister.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers own a huge stud farm and a horse racing business. When they learn that they have a common love interest, one of them tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Khwaja Mere Khwaja
programme.desc: The plot follows the downfall of the Quadri family due to betrayal and their subsequent pursuit of peace.

programme.title: Iron Man
programme.desc: Arms manufacturer Tony Stark is taken hostage by a terrorist group and realises the weapons his company build have been falling into the wrong hands. Using his engineering skills to construct a hi-tech armoured suit, he manages to escape and then puts the technology to good use in the fight against evil around the world. Superhero adventure, starring Robert Downey Jr, Jeff Bridges, Gwyneth Paltrow and Terrence Howard.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland
programme.desc: A girl meets a mysterious talking rabbit and follows the creature down a hole in the ground. She finds herself in a magical world inhabited by all manner of bizarre creatures and dominated by a short-tempered queen fond of beheading those who displease her. Disney animated fantasy based on Lewis Carroll's novel, with the voices of Kathryn Beaumont and Ed Wynn.

programme.title: The Aristocats
programme.desc: A jealous butler is outraged when his employer leaves a vast fortune to her cat and kittens instead of to him, so he drives the pets to the French countryside and dumps them. However, a streetwise alley cat steps in to help the pampered felines find their way home and claim their rightful inheritance. Animated adventure, with the voices of Eva Gabor, Phil Harris and Scatman Crothers.

programme.title: Piglet's Big Movie
programme.desc: The plucky porker is upset when his friends tell him he is too small to come honey-harvesting with them, so he embarks on an adventure of his own - and it is not long before his pals start to miss him and realise just how important he is. Animation, featuring the voices of John Fiedler, Jim Cummings and Andre Stojka.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: A street urchin is caught up in a scheming grand vizier's plot to get his clutches on a magical lamp. Retrieving the object from a wondrous cave, he releases a powerful genie trapped inside, whose ability to grant wishes helps the young hero thwart the villain's plans and woo a princess. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: The Princess Diaries
programme.desc: An ordinary teenager discovers she is descended from royal stock and her grandmother is a queen. However, when this formidable regal lady insists she learn to behave like a princess, life suddenly becomes very complicated. Family comedy, starring Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Heather Matarazzo and Hector Elizondo.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: Flubber
programme.desc: A scatty professor is in financial trouble, and his only hope of avoiding disaster is to market his latest invention - a strange rubbery substance with a life of its own. However, a criminal gang is determined to get hold of his creation. Remake of 1961 Disney comedy The Absent-Minded Professor, with Robin Williams, Marcia Gay Harden, Christopher McDonald and Wil Wheaton.

programme.title: Ratatouille
programme.desc: A rat finds his love of fine food has made him an outcast to his less discerning family. Separated from his fellow rodents by a storm, he winds up in a famous French restaurant, where he helps an incompetent kitchen assistant become the greatest chef in Paris. Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
programme.desc: An old man tells a journalist the story of his youth as a lobby boy at a hotel in Eastern Europe in the 1930s. He was taken under the wing of the establishment's dashing concierge, and is drawn into his misadventures as he becomes involved in a conflict over a valuable painting. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Ralph Fiennes, Tony Revolori, F Murray Abraham and Jude Law.

programme.title: Juno
programme.desc: A teenage girl finds herself pregnant after a one-night stand with her best friend. Deciding to give her baby up for adoption, she thinks she has found the perfect parents in a yuppie couple. However, over the next nine months she begins to experience doubts about her plans. Comedy, starring Elliot Page, Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner and Jason Bateman.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.desc: Marge and Homer sneak away on a second honeymoon, but Bart and Lisa are determined to deny them their privacy and start following them wherever they go. Meanwhile, Grampa catches the eye of a dashing Cuban man

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A tornado hits Springfield and Marge and Homer have a brush with death that prompts them to think about who would look after their kids if the worst were to happen. He's a surfer and she's an environmental lawyer - but are they just too good to be true?

programme.title: Below Deck: Mediterranean
programme.desc: Chef Josh has to contend with yet another strange dish, and a late night for the guests ends with the boat being damaged, sending the deck team into a panic

programme.title: Venom (2018)
programme.desc: While exploring space for new worlds, a probe belonging to the Life Foundation discovers a comet covered in symbiotic lifeforms. Following the probe's return to Earth, journalist Eddie Brock investigates sinister trials being carried out by the corporation, and after being infected by an alien symbiote, develops superhuman strength and power. Fantasy adventure, starring Tom Hardy and Riz Ahmed

programme.title: Gogglebox

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: The final three couples must prove they have the strongest connection, to be crowned winners and claim £50,000. Reality dating show hosted by Rylan Clark

programme.title: First Dates

Former reality TV star Aisleyne's date is Darren is a dead ringer for Jason Statham, but is he the alpha male she is looking for, or will his flirtatious banter go too far?

programme.title: Below Deck: Mediterranean
programme.desc: Chef Josh has to contend with yet another strange dish, and a late night for the guests ends with the boat being damaged, sending the deck team into a panic

programme.title: Abbott Elementary

programme.title: The Goldbergs

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Murray seems keen when Adam announces he wants to take up a new activity at school - until he discovers it is fencing. Beverly tries her hand at matchmaking. Ana Gasteyer (Suburgatory) guest stars

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Hoping that Pops' good luck can rub off on him, Adam takes to gambling at school - but ends up losing his toys. Erica wants to take part in a popular TV dance show, but when she gets the chance her dream quickly turns into a nightmare

programme.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to Murphy's Historic Hotel near Sacramento in northern California, where owners Brian, Kevin and Joel are often too distracted by their lively bar to look after their business. The national landmark, which has played host to an array of famous names including Mark Twain, President Ulysses S Grant and JP Morgan, has no dedicated accommodation manager, so guests sometimes struggle to receive the attention they need and end up feeling the hotel has become an afterthought beside the noisy saloon

programme.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Sandra Dee's, a seafood and barbecue restaurant in desperate need of a renovation in Sacramento, California. programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Baton RougeThe travelling chef ventures into Louisiana's state capital Baton Rouge to experience a unique American phenomenon - tailgating. It's the day of a big football match at Louisiana State University, and the LSU Tigers are playing in front of thousands of fans. Surrounded by people barbecuing, cooking and sharing food from the back of their pick-up trucks, James joins in and cooks up a storm ahead of the game. He also takes time out to visit a Baton Rouge-based oyster restaurant specialising in North American varieties.

programme.desc: 2026 Royal Ascot: Day ThreeEd Chamberlin and Francesca Cumani present coverage of day three of the festival, Ladies Day, including the highlight of the week the 4.15 Ascot Gold Cup. The historic race has produced some of Royal Ascot's most memorable moments, including Yeat's record fourth victory in 2009, Subjectivist's shock win in 2021 and Courage Mon Ami in 2023. programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: S1 E1Part one of two. Investigating the murders of Carol and Stephen Baxter, a wealthy couple in their 60s who were found dead by their daughter on Mersea Island in Essex on Easter Sunday in 2023. With no sign of struggle and carbon monoxide poisoning ruled out, a mysterious will that leaves everything to their daughter and a family friend points police in a new direction.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral: The Mother and Daughter Killers
programme.desc: With access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary explores true crime cases linked to the social media platform. In the early hours of the 11th of February, 2022, two 21-year-old men - Saqib Hussain and Hashim Ijazuddin - were found dead in a burning car on the A46 in Leicestershire. Police soon arrested two unlikely culprits - 22-year-old TikTok influencer Mahek Bukhari and her 45-year-old mother Ansreen.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E5Adil Ray hosts the game of words as former EastEnders star Natalie Cassidy and TV host Angellica Bell take on athletes Jonnie Peacock and Greg Rutherford for charity.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S1 E4It's all hands-on deck as the Fletchers gather in their expanded flock for an essential health check and orphaned lamb Aga is thriving wiith the family's constant care. programme.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught on Camera
programme.desc: S9 E1Eyewitness footage filmed by members of the public, including two first responders in Arizona who rescue a woman trapped in an inferno. In the mountains of East Asia, one traveller captures a once-in-a-lifetime experience on camera, while in Yorkshire, a commuter has a very close brush with death. In Australia, cameras follow fishermen who nearly became bait after their boat sank, and back in the UK, a toddler comes to her dad's rescue in the most remarkable way. Finally viewers meet a family whose US road trip was crashed by a furry friend. Roger Allam narrates.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Scotland v MoroccoScotland v Morocco (Kick-off 11.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Boston Stadium in the USA. This is the second World Cup meeting between these nations, with the previous one also being a group-stage match at France '98, the last time Scotland appeared at the finals. It was the Africans who came out on top with a comfortable 3-0 win in Saint-Étienne over a side that featured the likes of Jim Leighton, Colin Hendry, John Collins and Gordon Durie, and was managed by Craig Brown. Morocco suffered a barren World Cup run of their own following that contest and didn't qualify again until the 2018 tournament in Russia, when they were eliminated in the group stage. They qualified again four years later for the event in Qatar, where they produced their best performance as they reached the semi-finals, in which they lost 2-0 to France and went on to finish fourth. With analysis from Roy Keane, Duncan Ferguson and Ange Postocoglou,and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: S1 E1Part one of two. Investigating the murders of Carol and Stephen Baxter, a wealthy couple in their 60s who were found dead by their daughter on Mersea Island in Essex on Easter Sunday in 2023. With no sign of struggle and carbon monoxide poisoning ruled out, a mysterious will that leaves everything to their daughter and a family friend points police in a new direction.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral: The Mother and Daughter Killers
programme.desc: With access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary explores true crime cases linked to the social media platform. In the early hours of the 11th of February, 2022, two 21-year-old men - Saqib Hussain and Hashim Ijazuddin - were found dead in a burning car on the A46 in Leicestershire. Police soon arrested two unlikely culprits - 22-year-old TikTok influencer Mahek Bukhari and her 45-year-old mother Ansreen.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: E11882 — 19/06/2026Recent events set Debbie's nerves on edge at the hotel, Betsy informs Carla and Lisa of her decision to study in London, Sam asks to see Roy, and Maria doubts Gary's motive for booking a family holiday.

programme.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught on Camera
programme.desc: S9 E1Eyewitness footage filmed by members of the public, including two first responders in Arizona who rescue a woman trapped in an inferno. In the mountains of East Asia, one traveller captures a once-in-a-lifetime experience on camera, while in Yorkshire, a commuter has a very close brush with death. In Australia, cameras follow fishermen who nearly became bait after their boat sank, and back in the UK, a toddler comes to her dad's rescue in the most remarkable way. Finally viewers meet a family whose US road trip was crashed by a furry friend. Roger Allam narrates.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Scotland v MoroccoScotland v Morocco (Kick-off 11.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Boston Stadium in the USA. This is the second World Cup meeting between these nations, with the previous one also being a group-stage match at France '98, the last time Scotland appeared at the finals. It was the Africans who came out on top with a comfortable 3-0 win in Saint-Étienne over a side that featured the likes of Jim Leighton, Colin Hendry, John Collins and Gordon Durie, and was managed by Craig Brown. Morocco suffered a barren World Cup run of their own following that contest and didn't qualify again until the 2018 tournament in Russia, when they were eliminated in the group stage. They qualified again four years later for the event in Qatar, where they produced their best performance as they reached the semi-finals, in which they lost 2-0 to France and went on to finish fourth. With analysis from Roy Keane, Duncan Ferguson and Ange Postocoglou,and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Brazil v HaitiBrazil v Haiti (Kick-off 1.30am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Brazil were second best for most of their opener against Morocco, but came away with a 1-1 draw, while Haiti performed admirably in a 1-0 defeat to Scotland. Brazil have registered large victories in the two previous encounters between these nations, claiming a 6-0 win in an international friendly in 2004, and more recently a 7-1 triumph in the group stage of the 2016 Copa America, which also took place in the United States, and saw then-Liverpool attacking midfielder Philippe Coutinho score a hat-trick. Despite a relatively poor record in qualifying the Seleção will have high hopes of performing well under the stewardship of former Real Madrid, Chelsea and AC Milan manager Carlo Ancelotti, who was appointed in May last year on a one-year contract, which has since been extended for another four years, and anything other than a victory in this match will be considered a catastrophe. With analysis from Karen Carney and Emma Hayes, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Türkiye v ParaguayTürkiye v Paraguay (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group D match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Both sides need something from this fixture, with Türkiye abject in their 2-0 defeat to Australia, and Paraguay blown away by the USA in their opening contests. There has only been one previous meeting between these nations, a 0-0 draw in a 1995 friendly, but Paraguay will hope to emulate their results against European opposition in the group stage at their last World Cup appearance in South Africa in 2010, when they drew 1-1 against Italy and defeated Slovakia 2-0 on their way to finishing top of Group F. They subsequently overcame Japan in the last-16 via a penalty shootout, but then fell foul of a European nation in the quarter-finals, when they lost 1-0 to eventual champions Spain. With analysis from Juan Mata and Jobi McAnuff.

In Australia, cameras follow fishermen who nearly became bait after their boat sank, and back in the UK, a toddler comes to her dad's rescue in the most remarkable way. Finally viewers meet a family whose US road trip was crashed by a furry friend. Roger Allam narrates.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Scotland v MoroccoScotland v Morocco (Kick-off 11.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Boston Stadium in the USA. This is the second World Cup meeting between these nations, with the previous one also being a group-stage match at France '98, the last time Scotland appeared at the finals. It was the Africans who came out on top with a comfortable 3-0 win in Saint-Étienne over a side that featured the likes of Jim Leighton, Colin Hendry, John Collins and Gordon Durie, and was managed by Craig Brown. Morocco suffered a barren World Cup run of their own following that contest and didn't qualify again until the 2018 tournament in Russia, when they were eliminated in the group stage. They qualified again four years later for the event in Qatar, where they produced their best performance as they reached the semi-finals, in which they lost 2-0 to France and went on to finish fourth. With analysis from Roy Keane, Duncan Ferguson and Ange Postocoglou,and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Brazil v HaitiBrazil v Haiti (Kick-off 1.30am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Brazil were second best for most of their opener against Morocco, but came away with a 1-1 draw, while Haiti performed admirably in a 1-0 defeat to Scotland. Brazil have registered large victories in the two previous encounters between these nations, claiming a 6-0 win in an international friendly in 2004, and more recently a 7-1 triumph in the group stage of the 2016 Copa America, which also took place in the United States, and saw then-Liverpool attacking midfielder Philippe Coutinho score a hat-trick. Despite a relatively poor record in qualifying the Seleção will have high hopes of performing well under the stewardship of former Real Madrid, Chelsea and AC Milan manager Carlo Ancelotti, who was appointed in May last year on a one-year contract, which has since been extended for another four years, and anything other than a victory in this match will be considered a catastrophe. With analysis from Karen Carney and Emma Hayes, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Türkiye v ParaguayTürkiye v Paraguay (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group D match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Both sides need something from this fixture, with Türkiye abject in their 2-0 defeat to Australia, and Paraguay blown away by the USA in their opening contests. There has only been one previous meeting between these nations, a 0-0 draw in a 1995 friendly, but Paraguay will hope to emulate their results against European opposition in the group stage at their last World Cup appearance in South Africa in 2010, when they drew 1-1 against Italy and defeated Slovakia 2-0 on their way to finishing top of Group F. They subsequently overcame Japan in the last-16 via a penalty shootout, but then fell foul of a European nation in the quarter-finals, when they lost 1-0 to eventual champions Spain. With analysis from Juan Mata and Jobi McAnuff.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Baton RougeThe travelling chef ventures into Louisiana's state capital Baton Rouge to experience a unique American phenomenon - tailgating. It's the day of a big football match at Louisiana State University, and the LSU Tigers are playing in front of thousands of fans. Surrounded by people barbecuing, cooking and sharing food from the back of their pick-up trucks, James joins in and cooks up a storm ahead of the game. He also takes time out to visit a Baton Rouge-based oyster restaurant specialising in North American varieties.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: S1 E1Part one of two. With no sign of struggle and carbon monoxide poisoning ruled out, a mysterious will that leaves everything to their daughter and a family friend points police in a new direction.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral: The Mother and Daughter Killers
programme.desc: With access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary explores true crime cases linked to the social media platform. In the early hours of the 11th of February, 2022, two 21-year-old men - Saqib Hussain and Hashim Ijazuddin - were found dead in a burning car on the A46 in Leicestershire. Police soon arrested two unlikely culprits - 22-year-old TikTok influencer Mahek Bukhari and her 45-year-old mother Ansreen.

programme.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught on Camera
programme.desc: S9 E1Eyewitness footage filmed by members of the public, including two first responders in Arizona who rescue a woman trapped in an inferno. In the mountains of East Asia, one traveller captures a once-in-a-lifetime experience on camera, while in Yorkshire, a commuter has a very close brush with death. In Australia, cameras follow fishermen who nearly became bait after their boat sank, and back in the UK, a toddler comes to her dad's rescue in the most remarkable way. Finally viewers meet a family whose US road trip was crashed by a furry friend. Roger Allam narrates.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Scotland v MoroccoScotland v Morocco (Kick-off 11.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Boston Stadium in the USA. This is the second World Cup meeting between these nations, with the previous one also being a group-stage match at France '98, the last time Scotland appeared at the finals. It was the Africans who came out on top with a comfortable 3-0 win in Saint-Étienne over a side that featured the likes of Jim Leighton, Colin Hendry, John Collins and Gordon Durie, and was managed by Craig Brown. Morocco suffered a barren World Cup run of their own following that contest and didn't qualify again until the 2018 tournament in Russia, when they were eliminated in the group stage. They qualified again four years later for the event in Qatar, where they produced their best performance as they reached the semi-finals, in which they lost 2-0 to France and went on to finish fourth. With analysis from Roy Keane, Duncan Ferguson and Ange Postocoglou,and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Brazil v HaitiBrazil v Haiti (Kick-off 1.30am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Brazil were second best for most of their opener against Morocco, but came away with a 1-1 draw, while Haiti performed admirably in a 1-0 defeat to Scotland. Brazil have registered large victories in the two previous encounters between these nations, claiming a 6-0 win in an international friendly in 2004, and more recently a 7-1 triumph in the group stage of the 2016 Copa America, which also took place in the United States, and saw then-Liverpool attacking midfielder Philippe Coutinho score a hat-trick. Despite a relatively poor record in qualifying the Seleção will have high hopes of performing well under the stewardship of former Real Madrid, Chelsea and AC Milan manager Carlo Ancelotti, who was appointed in May last year on a one-year contract, which has since been extended for another four years, and anything other than a victory in this match will be considered a catastrophe. With analysis from Karen Carney and Emma Hayes, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Türkiye v ParaguayTürkiye v Paraguay (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group D match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Both sides need something from this fixture, with Türkiye abject in their 2-0 defeat to Australia, and Paraguay blown away by the USA in their opening contests. There has only been one previous meeting between these nations, a 0-0 draw in a 1995 friendly, but Paraguay will hope to emulate their results against European opposition in the group stage at their last World Cup appearance in South Africa in 2010, when they drew 1-1 against Italy and defeated Slovakia 2-0 on their way to finishing top of Group F. They subsequently overcame Japan in the last-16 via a penalty shootout, but then fell foul of a European nation in the quarter-finals, when they lost 1-0 to eventual champions Spain. With analysis from Juan Mata and Jobi McAnuff.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E2 — LossiemouthJames Martin and his travelling companion Nick Nairn continue their Scottish adventure in Lossiemouth, home to the first RAF squadron and a fleet of typhoon fighter jets. James fulfils a childhood dream and Nick takes part in a fitness test.

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: S12 E2 — ColourAlan Titchmarsh, David Domoney and Danny Clarke transform a small Leicester garden into a Caribbean-inspired paradise, showcasing how colour can reinvigorate outdoor spaces of any shape or size. Meanwhile in a separate garden, Frances Tophill reveals how to use light colour landscaping and shade loving flowers to bring vibrancy to dark and dingy corners.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S3 E9 — Sweet DelightsAinsley Harriott makes a selection of dishes with a sweet twist, including Korean-inspired pork skewers and an American favourite with spicy and sweet buffalo sauce. Paralympic swimmer Ellie Simmonds pops in to show how to make her family recipe for chocolate cheesecake, and Ainsley samples another Maltese classic.

Brazil have registered large victories in the two previous encounters between these nations, claiming a 6-0 win in an international friendly in 2004, and more recently a 7-1 triumph in the group stage of the 2016 Copa America, which also took place in the United States, and saw then-Liverpool attacking midfielder Philippe Coutinho score a hat-trick. Despite a relatively poor record in qualifying the Seleção will have high hopes of performing well under the stewardship of former Real Madrid, Chelsea and AC Milan manager Carlo Ancelotti, who was appointed in May last year on a one-year contract, which has since been extended for another four years, and anything other than a victory in this match will be considered a catastrophe. With analysis from Karen Carney and Emma Hayes, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Türkiye v ParaguayTürkiye v Paraguay (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group D match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Both sides need something from this fixture, with Türkiye abject in their 2-0 defeat to Australia, and Paraguay blown away by the USA in their opening contests. There has only been one previous meeting between these nations, a 0-0 draw in a 1995 friendly, but Paraguay will hope to emulate their results against European opposition in the group stage at their last World Cup appearance in South Africa in 2010, when they drew 1-1 against Italy and defeated Slovakia 2-0 on their way to finishing top of Group F. They subsequently overcame Japan in the last-16 via a penalty shootout, but then fell foul of a European nation in the quarter-finals, when they lost 1-0 to eventual champions Spain. With analysis from Juan Mata and Jobi McAnuff.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E2 — LossiemouthJames Martin and his travelling companion Nick Nairn continue their Scottish adventure in Lossiemouth, home to the first RAF squadron and a fleet of typhoon fighter jets. James fulfils a childhood dream and Nick takes part in a fitness test.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.desc: S1 E1Part one of two. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Scotland v MoroccoScotland v Morocco (Kick-off 11.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Boston Stadium in the USA. This is the second World Cup meeting between these nations, with the previous one also being a group-stage match at France '98, the last time Scotland appeared at the finals. It was the Africans who came out on top with a comfortable 3-0 win in Saint-Étienne over a side that featured the likes of Jim Leighton, Colin Hendry, John Collins and Gordon Durie, and was managed by Craig Brown. Morocco suffered a barren World Cup run of their own following that contest and didn't qualify again until the 2018 tournament in Russia, when they were eliminated in the group stage. They qualified again four years later for the event in Qatar, where they produced their best performance as they reached the semi-finals, in which they lost 2-0 to France and went on to finish fourth. With analysis from Roy Keane, Duncan Ferguson and Ange Postocoglou,and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: S1 E1Part one of two. Investigating the murders of Carol and Stephen Baxter, a wealthy couple in their 60s who were found dead by their daughter on Mersea Island in Essex on Easter Sunday in 2023. With no sign of struggle and carbon monoxide poisoning ruled out, a mysterious will that leaves everything to their daughter and a family friend points police in a new direction.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral: The Mother and Daughter Killers
programme.desc: With access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary explores true crime cases linked to the social media platform. In the early hours of the 11th of February, 2022, two 21-year-old men - Saqib Hussain and Hashim Ijazuddin - were found dead in a burning car on the A46 in Leicestershire. Police soon arrested two unlikely culprits - 22-year-old TikTok influencer Mahek Bukhari and her 45-year-old mother Ansreen.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S1 E4It's all hands-on deck as the Fletchers gather in their expanded flock for an essential health check and orphaned lamb Aga is thriving wiith the family's constant care. Kelvin has his sights set on some impressive livestock when he visits a local cattle breeder, the vet visits the farm to finally reveal if the pigs are pregnant, and the family visit their local summer fete for some quality time together.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: E11882 — 19/06/2026Recent events set Debbie's nerves on edge at the hotel, Betsy informs Carla and Lisa of her decision to study in London, Sam asks to see Roy, and Maria doubts Gary's motive for booking a family holiday.

programme.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught on Camera
programme.desc: S9 E1Eyewitness footage filmed by members of the public, including two first responders in Arizona who rescue a woman trapped in an inferno. In the mountains of East Asia, one traveller captures a once-in-a-lifetime experience on camera, while in Yorkshire, a commuter has a very close brush with death. In Australia, cameras follow fishermen who nearly became bait after their boat sank, and back in the UK, a toddler comes to her dad's rescue in the most remarkable way. Finally viewers meet a family whose US road trip was crashed by a furry friend. Roger Allam narrates.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Scotland v MoroccoScotland v Morocco (Kick-off 11.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Boston Stadium in the USA. This is the second World Cup meeting between these nations, with the previous one also being a group-stage match at France '98, the last time Scotland appeared at the finals. It was the Africans who came out on top with a comfortable 3-0 win in Saint-Étienne over a side that featured the likes of Jim Leighton, Colin Hendry, John Collins and Gordon Durie, and was managed by Craig Brown. Morocco suffered a barren World Cup run of their own following that contest and didn't qualify again until the 2018 tournament in Russia, when they were eliminated in the group stage. They qualified again four years later for the event in Qatar, where they produced their best performance as they reached the semi-finals, in which they lost 2-0 to France and went on to finish fourth. With analysis from Roy Keane, Duncan Ferguson and Ange Postocoglou,and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Brazil v HaitiBrazil v Haiti (Kick-off 1.30am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Brazil were second best for most of their opener against Morocco, but came away with a 1-1 draw, while Haiti performed admirably in a 1-0 defeat to Scotland. Brazil have registered large victories in the two previous encounters between these nations, claiming a 6-0 win in an international friendly in 2004, and more recently a 7-1 triumph in the group stage of the 2016 Copa America, which also took place in the United States, and saw then-Liverpool attacking midfielder Philippe Coutinho score a hat-trick. Despite a relatively poor record in qualifying the Seleção will have high hopes of performing well under the stewardship of former Real Madrid, Chelsea and AC Milan manager Carlo Ancelotti, who was appointed in May last year on a one-year contract, which has since been extended for another four years, and anything other than a victory in this match will be considered a catastrophe. With analysis from Karen Carney and Emma Hayes, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Türkiye v ParaguayTürkiye v Paraguay (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group D match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Both sides need something from this fixture, with Türkiye abject in their 2-0 defeat to Australia, and Paraguay blown away by the USA in their opening contests. There has only been one previous meeting between these nations, a 0-0 draw in a 1995 friendly, but Paraguay will hope to emulate their results against European opposition in the group stage at their last World Cup appearance in South Africa in 2010, when they drew 1-1 against Italy and defeated Slovakia 2-0 on their way to finishing top of Group F. They subsequently overcame Japan in the last-16 via a penalty shootout, but then fell foul of a European nation in the quarter-finals, when they lost 1-0 to eventual champions Spain. With analysis from Juan Mata and Jobi McAnuff.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E2 — LossiemouthJames Martin and his travelling companion Nick Nairn continue their Scottish adventure in Lossiemouth, home to the first RAF squadron and a fleet of typhoon fighter jets. James fulfils a childhood dream and Nick takes part in a fitness test.

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: S12 E2 — ColourAlan Titchmarsh, David Domoney and Danny Clarke transform a small Leicester garden into a Caribbean-inspired paradise, showcasing how colour can reinvigorate outdoor spaces of any shape or size. Meanwhile in a separate garden, Frances Tophill reveals how to use light colour landscaping and shade loving flowers to bring vibrancy to dark and dingy corners.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S3 E9 — Sweet DelightsAinsley Harriott makes a selection of dishes with a sweet twist, including Korean-inspired pork skewers and an American favourite with spicy and sweet buffalo sauce. Paralympic swimmer Ellie Simmonds pops in to show how to make her family recipe for chocolate cheesecake, and Ainsley samples another Maltese classic.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Baton RougeThe travelling chef ventures into Louisiana's state capital Baton Rouge to experience a unique American phenomenon - tailgating. programme.desc: E11882 — 19/06/2026Recent events set Debbie's nerves on edge at the hotel, Betsy informs Carla and Lisa of her decision to study in London, Sam asks to see Roy, and Maria doubts Gary's motive for booking a family holiday.

programme.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught on Camera
programme.desc: S9 E1Eyewitness footage filmed by members of the public, including two first responders in Arizona who rescue a woman trapped in an inferno. In the mountains of East Asia, one traveller captures a once-in-a-lifetime experience on camera, while in Yorkshire, a commuter has a very close brush with death. In Australia, cameras follow fishermen who nearly became bait after their boat sank, and back in the UK, a toddler comes to her dad's rescue in the most remarkable way. Finally viewers meet a family whose US road trip was crashed by a furry friend. Roger Allam narrates.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Scotland v MoroccoScotland v Morocco (Kick-off 11.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Boston Stadium in the USA. This is the second World Cup meeting between these nations, with the previous one also being a group-stage match at France '98, the last time Scotland appeared at the finals. It was the Africans who came out on top with a comfortable 3-0 win in Saint-Étienne over a side that featured the likes of Jim Leighton, Colin Hendry, John Collins and Gordon Durie, and was managed by Craig Brown. Morocco suffered a barren World Cup run of their own following that contest and didn't qualify again until the 2018 tournament in Russia, when they were eliminated in the group stage. They qualified again four years later for the event in Qatar, where they produced their best performance as they reached the semi-finals, in which they lost 2-0 to France and went on to finish fourth. With analysis from Roy Keane, Duncan Ferguson and Ange Postocoglou,and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Brazil v HaitiBrazil v Haiti (Kick-off 1.30am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Brazil were second best for most of their opener against Morocco, but came away with a 1-1 draw, while Haiti performed admirably in a 1-0 defeat to Scotland. Brazil have registered large victories in the two previous encounters between these nations, claiming a 6-0 win in an international friendly in 2004, and more recently a 7-1 triumph in the group stage of the 2016 Copa America, which also took place in the United States, and saw then-Liverpool attacking midfielder Philippe Coutinho score a hat-trick. Despite a relatively poor record in qualifying the Seleção will have high hopes of performing well under the stewardship of former Real Madrid, Chelsea and AC Milan manager Carlo Ancelotti, who was appointed in May last year on a one-year contract, which has since been extended for another four years, and anything other than a victory in this match will be considered a catastrophe. With analysis from Karen Carney and Emma Hayes, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Türkiye v ParaguayTürkiye v Paraguay (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group D match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Both sides need something from this fixture, with Türkiye abject in their 2-0 defeat to Australia, and Paraguay blown away by the USA in their opening contests. There has only been one previous meeting between these nations, a 0-0 draw in a 1995 friendly, but Paraguay will hope to emulate their results against European opposition in the group stage at their last World Cup appearance in South Africa in 2010, when they drew 1-1 against Italy and defeated Slovakia 2-0 on their way to finishing top of Group F. They subsequently overcame Japan in the last-16 via a penalty shootout, but then fell foul of a European nation in the quarter-finals, when they lost 1-0 to eventual champions Spain. With analysis from Juan Mata and Jobi McAnuff.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: S1 E1Part one of two. Investigating the murders of Carol and Stephen Baxter, a wealthy couple in their 60s who were found dead by their daughter on Mersea Island in Essex on Easter Sunday in 2023. With no sign of struggle and carbon monoxide poisoning ruled out, a mysterious will that leaves everything to their daughter and a family friend points police in a new direction.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral: The Mother and Daughter Killers
programme.desc: With access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary explores true crime cases linked to the social media platform. In the early hours of the 11th of February, 2022, two 21-year-old men - Saqib Hussain and Hashim Ijazuddin - were found dead in a burning car on the A46 in Leicestershire. Police soon arrested two unlikely culprits - 22-year-old TikTok influencer Mahek Bukhari and her 45-year-old mother Ansreen.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E5Adil Ray hosts the game of words as former EastEnders star Natalie Cassidy and TV host Angellica Bell take on athletes Jonnie Peacock and Greg Rutherford for charity.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S1 E4It's all hands-on deck as the Fletchers gather in their expanded flock for an essential health check and orphaned lamb Aga is thriving wiith the family's constant care. Kelvin has his sights set on some impressive livestock when he visits a local cattle breeder, the vet visits the farm to finally reveal if the pigs are pregnant, and the family visit their local summer fete for some quality time together.

Brazil have registered large victories in the two previous encounters between these nations, claiming a 6-0 win in an international friendly in 2004, and more recently a 7-1 triumph in the group stage of the 2016 Copa America, which also took place in the United States, and saw then-Liverpool attacking midfielder Philippe Coutinho score a hat-trick. Despite a relatively poor record in qualifying the Seleção will have high hopes of performing well under the stewardship of former Real Madrid, Chelsea and AC Milan manager Carlo Ancelotti, who was appointed in May last year on a one-year contract, which has since been extended for another four years, and anything other than a victory in this match will be considered a catastrophe. With analysis from Karen Carney and Emma Hayes, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Türkiye v ParaguayTürkiye v Paraguay (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group D match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Both sides need something from this fixture, with Türkiye abject in their 2-0 defeat to Australia, and Paraguay blown away by the USA in their opening contests. There has only been one previous meeting between these nations, a 0-0 draw in a 1995 friendly, but Paraguay will hope to emulate their results against European opposition in the group stage at their last World Cup appearance in South Africa in 2010, when they drew 1-1 against Italy and defeated Slovakia 2-0 on their way to finishing top of Group F. They subsequently overcame Japan in the last-16 via a penalty shootout, but then fell foul of a European nation in the quarter-finals, when they lost 1-0 to eventual champions Spain. With analysis from Juan Mata and Jobi McAnuff.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Scotland v MoroccoScotland v Morocco (Kick-off 11.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group C match at Boston Stadium in the USA. This is the second World Cup meeting between these nations, with the previous one also being a group-stage match at France '98, the last time Scotland appeared at the finals. It was the Africans who came out on top with a comfortable 3-0 win in Saint-Étienne over a side that featured the likes of Jim Leighton, Colin Hendry, John Collins and Gordon Durie, and was managed by Craig Brown. Morocco suffered a barren World Cup run of their own following that contest and didn't qualify again until the 2018 tournament in Russia, when they were eliminated in the group stage. They qualified again four years later for the event in Qatar, where they produced their best performance as they reached the semi-finals, in which they lost 2-0 to France and went on to finish fourth. With analysis from Roy Keane, Duncan Ferguson and Ange Postocoglou,and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.desc: Trevor McDonald investigates the case of serial child killer Beverley Allitt and reflects on how it was reported at the time. A combination of archive from the time, interviews with victims and expert analysis will piece together this tragic and shocking story.

programme.title: Dark Waters of Crime

programme.title: Dark Waters of Crime

programme.title: Dark Waters of Crime

programme.title: Dark Waters of Crime
programme.desc: When a body is discovered in a river, an autopsy discovers the victim had seven metres of ducktape wrapped around his head, and stab wounds to the chest.

programme.desc: Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

programme.desc: Focuses on the notorious house which the couple shared in Gloucester. Fred and Rose murdered their first three victims - Anna McFall, Charmaine West and then Rena Costello - because they `got in the way'. But when they moved into 25 Cromwell Street, the couple began to kill for sexual thrills.

programme.title: Fred and Rose: The West Murders

programme.title: Fred & Rose West: Love & Murder
programme.desc: Fred and Rose West raped, tortured and murdered at least a dozen young British girls between 1967 and 1987, including several of their own daughters. Learn how two of Britain's most notorious serial killers were able to get away with their crimes for so long, how they hid the victim's remains within the confines of their own home, and how they were eventually taken down.
